metadata.title: Predictors of Cognitive Skills Underlying Global Competences of Filipino Students in PISA 2018: A Machine-Learning Approach

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are Warm likelihood estimate (WLE) indices derived from self-report questionnaire items, rather than PV-based cognitive achievement.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use student weights or replicate weights despite the availability of sampling and replicate weights from PISA.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses individual-level models without mentioning any multilevel modeling or consideration of school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as train/test splits, indicating that it did not validate its findings on external datasets.
